ea_metadata.name: SMC_Unified_EA_v2
ea_metadata.author: Vignesh Kumaravel, SkyBlueFS 2025
ea_metadata.description: Smart Money Concepts: Order Blocks + FVG + BOS with Adaptive Filters

Strategy.description: Trading strategy: Auto uses all three strategies

MagicNumber.description: Unique identifier for this EA (prevents position conflicts)

OneTradePerBar.description: Maximum one trade per candle time period

LotPerK.description: Lots per $10,000 balance. 0.03 = 3 units per $10k = 0.3 lots per $100k

BagProfitPercent.description: Close ALL positions when equity reaches +X%

BagLossPercent.description: Close ALL positions when equity drops by X%

UseSessionFilter.description: Skip trading during Asian session (low liquidity, 1-7 UTC)

UseATRFilters.description: Scale all thresholds by ATR (adaptive to volatility)

UseRegimeFilter.description: Only trade BOS in trending markets (regime-based filter)

RegimeMethod.description: Trend detection: ADX (DM-based) or Efficiency Ratio (price action)

ATR_Period.description: ATR period for volatility measurement (used in SL/TP sizing)

SwingBars.description: Lookback bars for swing high/low confirmation

FibRetraceLevel.description: Fibonacci level for order block entry (% of swing range)

DisplacementMin.description: 0.0 = auto-adaptive based on ATR. Set > 0 for fixed threshold (e.g., 1.5)

MaxSpreadPoints.description: Maximum spread (in points) to allow trading

OrderBlock.entry: Touch 61.8% Fib retracement within OB zone
OrderBlock.optimal_conditions: End of strong trending move, confirmation candle

FairValueGap.entry: Price returns to fill gap zone

BreakOfStructure.detection: Price breaks swing high/low with displacement

integration_notes.python_bot: MT5 Python API can read trade comments to identify which strategy generated each trade
integration_notes.dashboard: Frontend displays all trades with strategy tags (OB/FVG/BOS)
integration_notes.backtesting: Use MT5 Strategy Tester (View → Strategy Tester) for historical analysis
integration_notes.live_trading: Ensure broker allows algorithmic trading and EA execution
integration_notes.broker_settings: Check spread, minimum lot size, maximum positions allowed
